independent_sample_margin_passes.note: primary sample A counted once (seed-7 run) plus each independent draw

hierarchical_variance.design_note: Sample A carries three stochastic runs on fixed questions; each further data seed is an independent question draw evaluated once. 'between_sample' compares the spread of sample means with the spread expected from question sampling alone; with fewer than three independent samples it is descriptive only.

decision_matrix.verdict_rule: Against the simple family {fixed-0..fixed-B, answer repetition}: L = some simple policy Pareto-dominates the learned policy on (EM, LLM calls); W = undominated and strictly dominates the training-selected fixed budget B*; T = undominated but does not strictly dominate B*. Certificate: corrected SGR at any target on the dedicated split (fresh runs only; historical cells are n/a).
